import pytest
from app.domain import SchedulerSettings
from app.logic import learning_delay_days

def test_returns_selected_step_for_good():
    settings = SchedulerSettings(learning_steps_days=(1, 3))
    step_index = 1
    hard = False
    expected = 3
    result = learning_delay_days(settings, step_index, hard)
    assert result == expected

def test_hard_uses_ceiling_of_one_point_five_times_delay():
    settings = SchedulerSettings(learning_steps_days=(1, 3))
    step_index = 0
    hard = True
    expected = 2
    result = learning_delay_days(settings, step_index, hard)
    assert result == expected

def test_empty_steps_falls_back_to_one_and_hard_is_two():
    settings = SchedulerSettings(learning_steps_days=())
    step_index = 9
    hard = True
    expected = 2
    result = learning_delay_days(settings, step_index, hard)
    assert result == expected

def test_negative_step_index_clamps_to_first_step():
    settings = SchedulerSettings(learning_steps_days=(2, 5))
    step_index = -1
    hard = False
    expected = 2
    result = learning_delay_days(settings, step_index, hard)
    assert result == expected

def test_oversized_step_index_clamps_to_last_step():
    settings = SchedulerSettings(learning_steps_days=(2, 5))
    step_index = 99
    hard = False
    expected = 5
    result = learning_delay_days(settings, step_index, hard)
    assert result == expected

    settings = SchedulerSettings(learning_steps_days=(0, -4, 3))
    step_index = 1
    hard = False
    expected = 1
    result = learning_delay_days(settings, step_index, hard)
    assert result == expected

def test_hard_delay_never_below_one_after_step_normalization():
    settings = SchedulerSettings(learning_steps_days=(0,))
    step_index = 0
    hard = True
    expected = 2
    result = learning_delay_days(settings, step_index, hard)
    assert result == expected

from app.domain import *
from app.abilities import *
from app.fakes import *
from app.logic import suspend_leech
import pytest
from datetime import datetime as dt


@pytest.fixture
def fake_repository():
    return InMemoryCardRepository()


def test_suspends_review_card_at_threshold_preserving_all_other_fields(fake_repository):
    card = Card(id='c1', note_id='n1', state=CardState.REVIEW, ease=2.5, 
                interval_days=21, due_date=date(2026, 10, 20), lapses=8, 
                learning_step=3, relearning_interval_days=5, 
                buried_until=date(2026, 10, 15), 
                history=(ReviewEvent(card_id='c1', reviewed_at=dt(2026, 10, 13, 9, 30), 
                                     grade=Grade.AGAIN, seconds=42, 
                                     state_before=CardState.REVIEW),))
    settings = SchedulerSettings(leech_threshold=8)
    
    result = suspend_leech(card, settings)
    
    expected = Card(id='c1', note_id='n1', state=CardState.SUSPENDED, ease=2.5, 
                    interval_days=21, due_date=date(2026, 10, 20), lapses=8, 
                    learning_step=3, relearning_interval_days=5, 
                    buried_until=date(2026, 10, 15), 
                    history=(ReviewEvent(card_id='c1', reviewed_at=dt(2026, 10, 13, 9, 30), 
                                         grade=Grade.AGAIN, seconds=42, 
                                         state_before=CardState.REVIEW),))
    
    assert result == expected


def test_returns_original_card_below_threshold(fake_repository):
    card = Card(id='c2', note_id='n2', state=CardState.REVIEW, ease=2.3, 
                interval_days=10, due_date=date(2026, 10, 14), lapses=7)
    settings = SchedulerSettings(leech_threshold=8)
    
    result = suspend_leech(card, settings)
    
    assert result is card


def test_suspends_card_above_threshold(fake_repository):
    card = Card(id='c3', note_id='n3', state=CardState.REVIEW, ease=1.3, 
                interval_days=1, due_date=date(2026, 10, 13), lapses=12)
    settings = SchedulerSettings(leech_threshold=8)
    
    result = suspend_leech(card, settings)
    
    expected = Card(id='c3', note_id='n3', state=CardState.SUSPENDED, ease=1.3, 
                    interval_days=1, due_date=date(2026, 10, 13), lapses=12)
    
    assert result == expected


def test_suspends_non_review_card_when_lapses_reach_threshold(fake_repository):
    card = Card(id='c4', note_id='n4', state=CardState.LEARNING, ease=2.0, 
                interval_days=0, due_date=date(2026, 10, 13), lapses=1, 
                learning_step=1)
    settings = SchedulerSettings(leech_threshold=1)
    
    result = suspend_leech(card, settings)
    
    expected = Card(id='c4', note_id='n4', state=CardState.SUSPENDED, ease=2.0, 
                    interval_days=0, due_date=date(2026, 10, 13), lapses=1, 
                    learning_step=1)
    
    assert result == expected


def test_does_not_suspend_when_leech_threshold_is_disabled(fake_repository):
    card = Card(id='c5', note_id='n5', state=CardState.REVIEW, ease=2.5, 
                interval_days=30, due_date=date(2026, 11, 12), lapses=99)
    settings = SchedulerSettings(leech_threshold=0)
    
    result = suspend_leech(card, settings)
    
    assert result is card

import pytest

    settings = SchedulerSettings()
    
    expected_card = Card(id='c1', note_id='n1', state=CardState.REVIEW, ease=2.5, interval_days=25, due_date=date(2026, 2, 4), lapses=2, learning_step=3, relearning_interval_days=6, buried_until=date(2026, 1, 20), history=(ReviewEvent(card_id='c1', reviewed_at=dt(2026, 1, 2, 9, 0), grade=Grade.GOOD, seconds=12, state_before=CardState.REVIEW),))

from app.domain import *
from app.abilities import *
from app.fakes import *
from app.logic import daily_summary
import pytest
from stateless import run, supply
from datetime import datetime as dt, date


def test_event_only_on_another_date_is_zero_summary():
    repo = InMemoryCardRepository(cards=(Card(
        id='c1',
        note_id='n1',
        state=CardState.REVIEW,
        ease=2.5,
        interval_days=10,
        due_date=date(2026, 10, 13),
        lapses=0,
        history=(ReviewEvent(
            card_id='c1',
            reviewed_at=dt(2026, 10, 12, 23, 59),
            grade=Grade.GOOD,
            seconds=42,
            state_before=CardState.REVIEW),
        ),
    ),))
    
    summary = run(supply(repo)(daily_summary)(date(2026, 10, 13)))

    expected = DailySummary(
        study_date=date(2026, 10, 13),
        grade_counts=((Grade.AGAIN, 0), (Grade.HARD, 0), (Grade.GOOD, 0), (Grade.EASY, 0)),
        retention_rate=0.0,
        total_seconds=0,
        reviewed_cards=0
    )

    assert summary == expected
    assert repo.saved_cards == []

def test_empty_repository_is_zero_summary():
    repo = InMemoryCardRepository(cards=())
    
    summary = run(supply(repo)(daily_summary)(date(2026, 10, 13)))

    expected = DailySummary(
        study_date=date(2026, 10, 13),
        grade_counts=((Grade.AGAIN, 0), (Grade.HARD, 0), (Grade.GOOD, 0), (Grade.EASY, 0)),
        retention_rate=0.0,
        total_seconds=0,
        reviewed_cards=0
    )

    assert summary == expected
    assert repo.saved_cards == []


def test_multiple_events_for_one_card_count_as_multiple_reviews():
    repo = InMemoryCardRepository(cards=(Card(
        id='c1',
        note_id='n1',
        state=CardState.REVIEW,
        ease=2.5,
        interval_days=10,
        due_date=date(2026, 10, 13),
        lapses=0,
        history=(
            ReviewEvent(
                card_id='c1',
                reviewed_at=dt(2026, 10, 13, 9, 0),
                grade=Grade.GOOD,
                seconds=7,
                state_before=CardState.REVIEW),
            ReviewEvent(
                card_id='c1',
                reviewed_at=dt(2026, 10, 13, 18, 0),
                grade=Grade.GOOD,
                seconds=10,
                state_before=CardState.REVIEW),
        ),
    ),))
    
    summary = run(supply(repo)(daily_summary)(date(2026, 10, 13)))

    expected = DailySummary(
        study_date=date(2026, 10, 13),
        grade_counts=((Grade.AGAIN, 0), (Grade.HARD, 0), (Grade.GOOD, 2), (Grade.EASY, 0)),
        retention_rate=1.0,
        total_seconds=17,
        reviewed_cards=2
    )
    
    assert summary == expected
    assert repo.saved_cards == []
